goal: Stop reporting disk read errors or index corruption as missing transactions during lookups
Alert RPC users and callers to actual disk or index failures instead of misleading not-found errors
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no blockers
agreement: Concept approval for separating unexpected read failures from missing transactions (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Nonblocking objection: pruned block queries returned an I/O error instead of block not available (yuvicc)
Author addressed the pruned block issue and pushed a fix awaiting re-review

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because it prevents txindex lookups from silently masking disk I/O errors or index corruption
Proper error reporting alerts operators to disk problems though corruption handling is deferrable

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it gives RPC clients accurate errors instead of false transaction-not-found responses
Pruned block lookups also receive clear error messages rather than generic lookup failures
